lang.telemetry_info.screen.description:
Collecting this data helps us improve Minecraft by guiding us in directions that are relevant to our players.
You can also send in additional feedback to help us keep improving Minecraft.
lang.telemetry_info.screen.title: Telemetry Data Collection
lang.telemetry.event.advancement_made.descrip: Understanding the context behind receiving an advancement can help us better understand and improve the progression of the game.
lang.telemetry.event.advancement_made.title: Advancement Made
lang.telemetry.event.game_load_times.descript: This event can help us figure out where startup performance improvements are needed by measuring the execution times of the startup phases.
lang.telemetry.event.game_load_times.title: Game Load Times
lang.telemetry.event.graphics_capabilities.de: This event informs us of the capabilities of the graphics device used to play the game.
lang.telemetry.event.p2p_connection.descripti: This event helps us understand the reliability and performance of peer-to-peer connections between players. It records whether the connection was successful, the type of Interactive Connectivity Establishment (ICE, the protocol we use to establish peer-to-peer connections) candidate used, and how long it took to establish the connection.
lang.telemetry.event.p2p_connection.title: Peer-to-peer Connection
lang.telemetry.event.performance_metrics.desc:
Knowing the overall performance profile of Minecraft helps us tune and optimize the game for a wide range of machine specifications and operating systems.
Game version is included to help us compare the performance profile for new versions of Minecraft.
lang.telemetry.event.world_load_times.descrip: It's important for us to understand how long it takes to join a world, and how that changes over time. For example, when we add new features or do larger technical changes, we need to see what impact that had on load times.
lang.telemetry.event.world_load_times.title: World Load Times
lang.telemetry.event.world_loaded.description:
Knowing how players play Minecraft (such as Game Mode, client or server modded, and game version) allows us to focus game updates to improve the areas that players care about most.
The World Loaded event is paired with the World Unloaded event to calculate how long the play session has lasted.
lang.telemetry.event.world_loaded.title: World Loaded
lang.telemetry.event.world_unloaded.descripti:
This event is paired with the World Loaded event to calculate how long the world session has lasted.
The duration (in seconds and ticks) is measured when a world session has ended (quitting to title, disconnecting from a server).
